risk_summary: The excerpt discloses meaningful risks, including the retail-business exit, operating losses, customer and product concentration, pricing pressure, supplier cost inflation, margin compression, and volatile order flows. Liquidity is presented as adequate, with quantified ratios, working capital, and no debt, but forward-looking claims rely heavily on standard disclaimers and unverified expectations. An additional $0.2–$0.4 million discontinued-operations loss is anticipated through January 2013.
